{{Quote|Uh, the navicomputer is heading us right into the moon!|A [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]], shortly before the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} destruction|<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" />}}
The '''Dead Moon of Antar''', also known as the '''Antar Moon''' or simply '''Antar''', was one of two uninhabitable [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Antar/Legends|Antar]], a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] located in the [[Prindaar system/Legends|Prindaar system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. [[Dead Moon of Antar colony|Colonized]] by the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotals]] of [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]] before their discovery by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|collided]] with the barren moon during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which resulted in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] destruction.

==Description==
The Dead Moon of Antar was a barren,<ref name="LEGO Star Wars III" /> terrestrial [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" /> It was one of two uninhabitable moons that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] [[Antar/Legends|Antar]], a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> located in the [[Prindaar system/Legends|Prindaar system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] region<ref name="TEA" /> of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Sometimes, the Dead Moon of Antar and its sister moons illuminated [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4's]] nights.<ref name="Second Edition">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref>

==History==
Because of its proximity to the Dead Moon of Antar and its sisters, Antar 4's [[Homeworld/Legends|indigenous]] [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] population was relatively proficient in the complexities of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] travel, establishing colonies on four of the five [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoids]],<ref name="Second Edition" /> [[Dead Moon of Antar colony|including]] the Dead Moon of Antar,<ref name="Colony" /> and [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Antar 5]] even before their discovery by the marauding explorers of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Second Edition" /> sometime between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]].<ref name="Dating">According to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', [[Antar/Legends|Antar]] became a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sometime between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]]. As [[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edtion]] established that [[Gotal/Legends|Gotals]] had colonized four of [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4's]] five sister [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and [[Mining/Legends|mined]] [[Antar 5]] before their discovery by the Galactic Republic, it can be determined that these event occurred sometime before or between 25,000 BBY and 22,000 BBY.</ref> In the [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first year of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="FF-2014 24: Malevolence">{{FactFile2014|24|22 BBY 87-88|The ''Malevolence'' Campaign}}</ref> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] boarded the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] during the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] and sabotaged its [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]], destroying the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] when it activated its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] while on a collision course with the dead moon.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" />

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
The mighty [[Starship/Legends|starship]] lay in scattered pieces on Antar's barren moon. However, some of the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} crew survived its destruction and searched for a way off the Dead Moon of Antar before the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] could finish them off. The panicking [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were able to construct an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] and flee Republic forces.<ref name="LEGO Star Wars III" />
{{Noncanonend}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The idea being that we haven't seen a ship smash into a planet at the speed of light or in hyperspace, so this was the opportunity to show it, and what better ship than the ''Malevolence''?|[[Henry Gilroy]], on the Dead Moon of Antar's role in the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} destruction|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One]]</ref>}}
The Dead Moon of Antar was first mentioned, albeit indirectly, in ''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]'', a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] supplement written by [[Troy Denning]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> and released on [[June 1]], [[1989]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races release date">{{CargoBay|url=item-detail/7768|text=Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races}}</ref> It first appeared, albeit unidentified, in "[[Destroy Malevolence]]," the fourth episode of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''{{'}} [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]],<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" /> which originally aired on [[October 17]], [[2008]].<ref name="Episode Guide" /> The dead moon was first identified as a "dead moon of Antar" in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|280|''Malevolence'' (I)}}</ref> a three-volume reference book edited by [[Bob Vitas]]<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and released on [[December 9]], 2008.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia release date">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/160596/the-complete-star-wars-encyclopedia-by-stephen-j-sansweet-pablo-hidalgo-bob-vitas-daniel-wallace/9780345477637|text=The Complete Star Wars® Encyclopedia by Stephen J. Sansweet, Pablo Hidalgo, Bob Vitas, Daniel Wallace}}</ref>

''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]<ref name="TEA" /> and released on [[August 18]], [[2009]],<ref name="TEA release date">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> placed the Antar system, and therefore the Dead Moon of Antar, in grid square N-12.<ref name="TEA" />
